facts.fact: Established in 2021 (brand's own site footer: 'Established in 2021, Purple Mountain Observatory is an outdoors and activewear brand that emerged from a profound love for nature yet draws inspiration from the dynamic urban landscape').
Founded by Georgia Smith and Matt Braun in 2021 during the COVID-19 pandemic; London label.
Founded by outdoor enthusiasts Matt Braun and Georgia Smith; London-based; established 2021.
Matt Braun grew up in Barking, East London, and spent over two decades in design roles for other labels before PMO.
Name comes from Purple Mountain (Zijin Shan) above Nanjing, China, home to China's first modern observatory, near where the clothing is made.

Known for unisex outerwear for trail and town, color-changing thermo-sensitive fabrics (e.g. Obsidian Jacket), bold color-blocked prints, and community group hikes in the UK; East London label. (Note: Field Mag says 'founded in 2023' and Urban Industry says 2020; brand site, Highsnobiety and Deadstock say 2021.)
Works with named technical fabrics across the range: PrimaLoft Active Evolve, Polartec Alpha Direct, Toray DOT AIR, ALUULA, YKK Vislon hardware.

quotes.quote: Growing up in the UK you’re used to weather that can turn on you in minutes, I remember it being Summer time and we’d get pelted on by horizontal rain, and in Winter, damp cold, wind that cuts through everything. You need clothes that can handle that without feeling like mountaineering kit.
I was brought up with my old man always stating “there’s no such thing as bad weather, just bad clothing”
When you put that PMO jacket on you feel a sense of home, whether you’re on top of a mountain or standing waiting for the bus.
Every detail, from articulated patterning to lightweight hardware, is calibrated for being on the move.

products.name: Mogul Pant
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Black / XL, Olive / XS
features: Hard-wearing cotton-nylon blend
Wider fit inspired by movement-focused outdoor silhouettes; multi-pocket system
products.golf_note: Roomy through the leg so a full turn never pulls, and the cotton-nylon blend shrugs off a muddy knee from reading putts. Olive or black both pass on a muni.

products.name: City Pant
features: Premium Japanese double-weave fabric with stretch and weather resistance
Water-resistant with UV protection; articulated patterning; two-zip pocketing
products.golf_note: The cleanest-looking pant here: stretch double-weave that sheds morning drizzle and looks tailored enough for the clubhouse. Zip pockets keep a ball marker and keys from falling out mid-swing.

products.name: Deluge Pant
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Green / XS, Green / S, Black / XS, Black / XL
features: Lightweight waterproof fabric with ultrasonic welded seams and internal taping
Three front pockets with YKK magnetic zips; gusseted zip openings; adjustable hem cords
products.golf_note: A real rain over-trouser for the wet January round. Gusseted openings help with movement, and front pockets mean you can still reach tees without unzipping a layer.

products.name: Climate Shirt
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Black / XS, Black / XL, Olive / XS
features: Breathable premium nylon with ultrasonic taped seams
Water-resistant; YKK Vislon zip
products.golf_note: An overshirt that does the job of a light jacket: water-resistant nylon for a damp first nine, easy to unzip as the day warms past 50.

products.name: Stinger Jacket
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Black / XS, Black / S, Olive / XS, Olive / L
features: 2-layer ripstop weighing just 165g with microporous membrane; fully taped seams
Ventilation pocketing, action hood, pack-away bag
products.golf_note: At 165g it is the lightest shell here, so it swings like a windshirt but blocks wind and rain. Packs into its own bag and lives in the golf bag all winter.

products.name: Breeze Ombre Jacket
features: Mini-ripstop nylon with DWR finish and ultrasonic taped seams
Breathable mesh panels, ventilated back yoke and an action back for unrestricted movement
products.golf_note: The action back is exactly what you want in a golf shell: room across the shoulders at the top of the backswing. DWR handles light rain; the ombre print gives it some personality on the tee.

products.name: PrimaLoft® Ursa Pullover
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Cement / XS, Apple / XS, Apple / XL
features: PrimaLoft Active Evolve fabric for breathable warmth during movement
Articulated flatlock seam panels; thumb loops with elastic-bound cuffs
products.golf_note: A breathable fleece crew that keeps you warm on a 38-degree first tee without overheating by the turn. Articulated seams keep the shoulders free.

products.name: PrimaLoft® Ursa Hoodie
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Cement / XS, Cement / XL, Black / XL
features: PrimaLoft Active Evolve fabric
Articulated flatlock seam panels; elastic binding at cuffs, centre front zip and hood; thumb loops
products.golf_note: Same breathable PrimaLoft fleece with a half-zip and hood for the windiest mornings; zip it open once you are moving.

products.name: Polartec® Alpha™ Direct 90 Pullover
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Black / XL
features: Polartec Alpha Direct 90 fleece for dynamic insulation
Built for stop-and-go pursuits; moisture-resistant and quick-drying
products.golf_note: Golf is the definition of stop-and-go: warm while you wait on the group ahead, vents heat when you walk. Thin enough to wear under a shell without bulk.

products.name: Waffle LS
products.stock: In stock; sold out: Olive / XS, Black / XS
features: Sweat-wicking, quick-drying lightweight waffle knit
Heat-sealed front pocket with hidden YKK magnetic zip
products.golf_note: A base or standalone long sleeve for 50-60 degree days. Quick-drying waffle handles sweat, and the zip pocket is the right size for a scorecard pencil and tees.

products.name: Tech Ripstop Air Cap
features: Lightweight ripstop with ventilated side panels
Quick-release puller at the rear; 3M reflective branding
products.golf_note: A ventilated ripstop sports cap that keeps the sun out of your eyes, dries fast after a drizzle, and adjusts in a second with the rear puller.

products.name: PrimaLoft® Ursa Beanie
features: PrimaLoft Active Evolve fabric for lightweight, breathable warmth
Textured knit structure enhances airflow while retaining insulation
products.golf_note: For the 7 a.m. frost-delay tee time. Breathable enough that you will not want to pull it off after a few holes of walking.
